title: Settled Codex child release barriers keep a dedicated server's process handle until the session is removed
outcome: CodexDelegationRelease::record_archive_origin keeps (runtime_id, Arc<SharedChild>, profile) after the archive settles. With delegation-owned servers each completed child now retains a different exited process (a handle on Windows) until its barrier is replaced or the session removed. Keep the origin process only while an ambiguous archive still needs exit proof.
acceptance: Once a child's archive outcome is known, its release barrier holds no process handle of the server; a behaviour test shows the handle released after a settled archive.
